§eFlat worlds§f do not have any hills or trees, just an infinite flat area to fill with your creations.

source_string: Jigsaw Blocks give creators the ability to generate large structures in the world by connecting multiple structure templates.
translation: ˙sǝʇɐꞁdɯǝʇ ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇs ǝꞁdᴉʇꞁnɯ ᵷuᴉʇɔǝuuoɔ ʎq pꞁɹoʍ ǝɥʇ uᴉ sǝɹnʇɔnɹʇs ǝᵷɹɐꞁ ǝʇɐɹǝuǝᵷ oʇ ʎʇᴉꞁᴉqɐ ǝɥʇ sɹoʇɐǝɹɔ ǝʌᴉᵷ sʞɔoꞁᗺ ʍɐsᵷᴉՐ

source_string: Jigsaw Blocks have multiple settings that control how they join together to form a larger structure.
translation: ˙ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇs ɹǝᵷɹɐꞁ ɐ ɯɹoɟ oʇ ɹǝɥʇǝᵷoʇ uᴉoɾ ʎǝɥʇ ʍoɥ ꞁoɹʇuoɔ ʇɐɥʇ sᵷuᴉʇʇǝs ǝꞁdᴉʇꞁnɯ ǝʌɐɥ sʞɔoꞁᗺ ʍɐsᵷᴉՐ

source_string: §eTarget Pool§f - The path of the template pool to search for a connecting structure template. The template pool should contain at least one structure that matches the Jigsaw's "Target Name" field.
translation: §eꞁooԀ ʇǝᵷɹɐ⟘§f˙pꞁǝᴉɟ "ǝɯɐN ʇǝᵷɹɐ⟘" s,ʍɐsᵷᴉՐ ǝɥʇ sǝɥɔʇɐɯ ʇɐɥʇ ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇs ǝuo ʇsɐǝꞁ ʇɐ uᴉɐʇuoɔ pꞁnoɥs ꞁood ǝʇɐꞁdɯǝʇ ǝɥ⟘ ˙ǝʇɐꞁdɯǝʇ ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇs ᵷuᴉʇɔǝuuoɔ ɐ ɹoɟ ɥɔɹɐǝs oʇ ꞁood ǝʇɐꞁdɯǝʇ ǝɥʇ ɟo ɥʇɐd ǝɥ⟘ -

source_string: §eName§f - The name of the Jigsaw. This is used when connecting from Jigsaws with a matching "Target Name".
translation: §eǝɯɐN§f˙"ǝɯɐN ʇǝᵷɹɐ⟘" ᵷuᴉɥɔʇɐɯ ɐ ɥʇᴉʍ sʍɐsᵷᴉՐ ɯoɹɟ ᵷuᴉʇɔǝuuoɔ uǝɥʍ pǝsn sᴉ sᴉɥ⟘ ˙ʍɐsᵷᴉՐ ǝɥʇ ɟo ǝɯɐu ǝɥ⟘ -

source_string: §eTurns Into§f - The type of block the Jigsaw Block will turn into when placed in the world during structure generation.
translation: §eoʇuI suɹn⟘§f˙uoᴉʇɐɹǝuǝᵷ ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇs ᵷuᴉɹnp pꞁɹoʍ ǝɥʇ uᴉ pǝɔɐꞁd uǝɥʍ oʇuᴉ uɹnʇ ꞁꞁᴉʍ ʞɔoꞁᗺ ʍɐsᵷᴉՐ ǝɥʇ ʞɔoꞁq ɟo ǝdʎʇ ǝɥ⟘ -

source_string: §eSelection Priority§f - When the parent piece is being processed for connections, this is the order in which this Jigsaw block attempts to connect to its target piece. Jigsaws will be processed in descending priority with random ordering breaking ties.
translation: §eʎʇᴉɹoᴉɹԀ uoᴉʇɔǝꞁǝS§f˙sǝᴉʇ ᵷuᴉʞɐǝɹq ᵷuᴉɹǝpɹo ɯopuɐɹ ɥʇᴉʍ ʎʇᴉɹoᴉɹd ᵷuᴉpuǝɔsǝp uᴉ pǝssǝɔoɹd ǝq ꞁꞁᴉʍ sʍɐsᵷᴉՐ ˙ǝɔǝᴉd ʇǝᵷɹɐʇ sʇᴉ oʇ ʇɔǝuuoɔ oʇ sʇdɯǝʇʇɐ ʞɔoꞁq ʍɐsᵷᴉՐ sᴉɥʇ ɥɔᴉɥʍ uᴉ ɹǝpɹo ǝɥʇ sᴉ sᴉɥʇ 'suoᴉʇɔǝuuoɔ ɹoɟ pǝssǝɔoɹd ᵷuᴉǝq sᴉ ǝɔǝᴉd ʇuǝɹɐd ǝɥʇ uǝɥM -

source_string: §ePlacement Priority§f - When this Jigsaw block connects to a piece, this is the order in which that piece is processed for connections in the wider structure. Pieces will be processed in descending priority with insertion order breaking ties.
translation: §eʎʇᴉɹoᴉɹԀ ʇuǝɯǝɔɐꞁԀ§f˙sǝᴉʇ ᵷuᴉʞɐǝɹq ɹǝpɹo uoᴉʇɹǝsuᴉ ɥʇᴉʍ ʎʇᴉɹoᴉɹd ᵷuᴉpuǝɔsǝp uᴉ pǝssǝɔoɹd ǝq ꞁꞁᴉʍ sǝɔǝᴉԀ ˙ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇs ɹǝpᴉʍ ǝɥʇ uᴉ suoᴉʇɔǝuuoɔ ɹoɟ pǝssǝɔoɹd sᴉ ǝɔǝᴉd ʇɐɥʇ ɥɔᴉɥʍ uᴉ ɹǝpɹo ǝɥʇ sᴉ sᴉɥʇ 'ǝɔǝᴉd ɐ oʇ sʇɔǝuuoɔ ʞɔoꞁq ʍɐsᵷᴉՐ sᴉɥʇ uǝɥM -

source_string: §eJoint Type§f - A joint can be either Rollable (default) or Aligned. If the joint type is Rollable, the target structure will be rotated randomly around the source Jigsaw Block. If the joint type is Aligned, the target structure will be placed such that the rotation of the target Jigsaw Block aligns with the rotation of the source Jigsaw Block. Note that this only applies when the Jigsaw Block is placed facing up or down.

translation: ˙dɐW ɹnoʎ ʎdoɔ ɹo puɐdxǝ noʎ ʇǝꞁ ꞁꞁᴉʍ dɐW ʞuɐꞁq ɐ ɹo ɹǝdɐԀ ᵷuᴉppⱯ ˙dɐW ɹoʇɐɔoꞀ ɐ ʇɟɐɹɔ uɐɔ noʎ ʇoꞁs puoɔǝs ǝɥʇ oʇuᴉ ssɐdɯoɔ ɐ ppɐ noʎ ɟI ˙dɐW ɐ ʇɟɐɹɔ oʇ ʇoꞁs ʇsɹᴉɟ ǝɥʇ oʇuᴉ ɹǝdɐd ǝɔɐꞁԀ

source_string: Try to watch for landmarks as you explore. The more you play on a world, the more you will be able to remember where you are. Another good trick is to place Torches as you go so that you may find your way back home.
translation: ˙ǝɯoɥ ʞɔɐq ʎɐʍ ɹnoʎ puᴉɟ ʎɐɯ noʎ ʇɐɥʇ os oᵷ noʎ sɐ sǝɥɔɹo⟘ ǝɔɐꞁd oʇ sᴉ ʞɔᴉɹʇ pooᵷ ɹǝɥʇouⱯ ˙ǝɹɐ noʎ ǝɹǝɥʍ ɹǝqɯǝɯǝɹ oʇ ǝꞁqɐ ǝq ꞁꞁᴉʍ noʎ ǝɹoɯ ǝɥʇ 'pꞁɹoʍ ɐ uo ʎɐꞁd noʎ ǝɹoɯ ǝɥ⟘ ˙ǝɹoꞁdxǝ noʎ sɐ sʞɹɐɯpuɐꞁ ɹoɟ ɥɔʇɐʍ oʇ ʎɹ⟘

source_string: The sun can also tell you what direction you are facing. Remember: the sun rises in the east and sets in the west!
translation: ¡ʇsǝʍ ǝɥʇ uᴉ sʇǝs puɐ ʇsɐǝ ǝɥʇ uᴉ sǝsᴉɹ uns ǝɥʇ :ɹǝqɯǝɯǝᴚ ˙ᵷuᴉɔɐɟ ǝɹɐ noʎ uoᴉʇɔǝɹᴉp ʇɐɥʍ noʎ ꞁꞁǝʇ osꞁɐ uɐɔ uns ǝɥ⟘

source_string: There are several places for you to explore. Find a village and look for a Cartographer. He will trade you Explorer Maps that will lead you to strange places very far away.
translation: ˙ʎɐʍɐ ɹɐɟ ʎɹǝʌ sǝɔɐꞁd ǝᵷuɐɹʇs oʇ noʎ pɐǝꞁ ꞁꞁᴉʍ ʇɐɥʇ sdɐW ɹǝɹoꞁdxƎ noʎ ǝpɐɹʇ ꞁꞁᴉʍ ǝH ˙ɹǝɥdɐɹᵷoʇɹɐƆ ɐ ɹoɟ ʞooꞁ puɐ ǝᵷɐꞁꞁᴉʌ ɐ puᴉℲ ˙ǝɹoꞁdxǝ oʇ noʎ ɹoɟ sǝɔɐꞁd ꞁɐɹǝʌǝs ǝɹɐ ǝɹǝɥ⟘

source_string: A Nether Portal allows you to travel to a different dimension.
translation: ˙uoᴉsuǝɯᴉp ʇuǝɹǝɟɟᴉp ɐ oʇ ꞁǝʌɐɹʇ oʇ noʎ sʍoꞁꞁɐ ꞁɐʇɹoԀ ɹǝɥʇǝN Ɐ

source_string: If constructed correctly the Nether Portal can be lit and activated.
translation: ˙pǝʇɐʌᴉʇɔɐ puɐ ʇᴉꞁ ǝq uɐɔ ꞁɐʇɹoԀ ɹǝɥʇǝN ǝɥʇ ʎꞁʇɔǝɹɹoɔ pǝʇɔnɹʇsuoɔ ɟI

source_string: Example of a portal construction shown here:
translation: :ǝɹǝɥ uʍoɥs uoᴉʇɔnɹʇsuoɔ ꞁɐʇɹod ɐ ɟo ǝꞁdɯɐxƎ

source_string: In Minecraft, the sun rises and sets as you adventure in your world. As the sun sets, you must take precautions. There are many dangers at night!
translation: ¡ʇɥᵷᴉu ʇɐ sɹǝᵷuɐp ʎuɐɯ ǝɹɐ ǝɹǝɥ⟘ ˙suoᴉʇnɐɔǝɹd ǝʞɐʇ ʇsnɯ noʎ 'sʇǝs uns ǝɥʇ sⱯ ˙pꞁɹoʍ ɹnoʎ uᴉ ǝɹnʇuǝʌpɐ noʎ sɐ sʇǝs puɐ sǝsᴉɹ uns ǝɥʇ 'ʇɟɐɹɔǝuᴉW uI

source_string: If you have not already, you will need a place to take shelter from the dark and what lurks within it. This can be as simple as a hole in the side of a hill or a small cabin in the forest.
translation: ˙ʇsǝɹoɟ ǝɥʇ uᴉ uᴉqɐɔ ꞁꞁɐɯs ɐ ɹo ꞁꞁᴉɥ ɐ ɟo ǝpᴉs ǝɥʇ uᴉ ǝꞁoɥ ɐ sɐ ǝꞁdɯᴉs sɐ ǝq uɐɔ sᴉɥ⟘ ˙ʇᴉ uᴉɥʇᴉʍ sʞɹnꞁ ʇɐɥʍ puɐ ʞɹɐp ǝɥʇ ɯoɹɟ ɹǝʇꞁǝɥs ǝʞɐʇ oʇ ǝɔɐꞁd ɐ pǝǝu ꞁꞁᴉʍ noʎ 'ʎpɐǝɹꞁɐ ʇou ǝʌɐɥ noʎ ɟI

source_string: Be sure to block off all entrances, you may want to use a door so you can go in and out. If you have made a bed this is a good place to put it along with your Crafting Table and Furnace.
translation: ˙ǝɔɐuɹnℲ puɐ ǝꞁqɐ⟘ ᵷuᴉʇɟɐɹƆ ɹnoʎ ɥʇᴉʍ ᵷuoꞁɐ ʇᴉ ʇnd oʇ ǝɔɐꞁd pooᵷ ɐ sᴉ sᴉɥʇ pǝq ɐ ǝpɐɯ ǝʌɐɥ noʎ ɟI ˙ʇno puɐ uᴉ oᵷ uɐɔ noʎ os ɹoop ɐ ǝsn oʇ ʇuɐʍ ʎɐɯ noʎ 'sǝɔuɐɹʇuǝ ꞁꞁɐ ɟɟo ʞɔoꞁq oʇ ǝɹns ǝᗺ

source_string: Also be sure to light up the area with torches, it may save your life.
translation: ˙ǝɟᴉꞁ ɹnoʎ ǝʌɐs ʎɐɯ ʇᴉ 'sǝɥɔɹoʇ ɥʇᴉʍ ɐǝɹɐ ǝɥʇ dn ʇɥᵷᴉꞁ oʇ ǝɹns ǝq osꞁⱯ

source_string: When the sun starts to set, it's time to get ready.
translation: ˙ʎpɐǝɹ ʇǝᵷ oʇ ǝɯᴉʇ s,ʇᴉ 'ʇǝs oʇ sʇɹɐʇs uns ǝɥʇ uǝɥM

source_string: At night, the Overworld is home to zombies, spiders, skeletons, and other dangerous creatures we call §ehostile mobs§f.
translation: ꞁꞁɐɔ ǝʍ sǝɹnʇɐǝɹɔ snoɹǝᵷuɐp ɹǝɥʇo puɐ 'suoʇǝꞁǝʞs 'sɹǝpᴉds 'sǝᴉqɯoz oʇ ǝɯoɥ sᴉ pꞁɹoʍɹǝʌO ǝɥʇ 'ʇɥᵷᴉu ʇⱯ§esqoɯ ǝꞁᴉʇsoɥ§f˙

source_string: Crafting some §etorches§f can help you see in the dark, while also keeping mobs from spawning too close.
translation: ǝɯos ᵷuᴉʇɟɐɹƆ§esǝɥɔɹoʇ§f˙ǝsoꞁɔ ooʇ ᵷuᴉuʍɐds ɯoɹɟ sqoɯ ᵷuᴉdǝǝʞ osꞁɐ ǝꞁᴉɥʍ 'ʞɹɐp ǝɥʇ uᴉ ǝǝs noʎ dꞁǝɥ uɐɔ

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by right-clicking a nearby free surface.
translation: ˙ǝɔɐɟɹns ǝǝɹɟ ʎqɹɐǝu ɐ ᵷuᴉʞɔᴉꞁɔ-ʇɥᵷᴉɹ ʎq pꞁɹoʍ ǝɥʇ oʇuᴉ ʇᴉ ǝɔɐꞁd 'ɥɔɹoʇ ɐ ᵷuᴉpꞁoɥ ǝꞁᴉɥM

translation: ˙:ǝsn˙ʎǝʞ_ʇnduᴉ_: ᵷuᴉssǝɹd ʎq pꞁɹoʍ ǝɥʇ oʇuᴉ ʇᴉ ǝɔɐꞁd 'ɥɔɹoʇ ɐ ᵷuᴉpꞁoɥ ǝꞁᴉɥM

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by tapping a nearby free surface.
translation: ˙ǝɔɐɟɹns ǝǝɹɟ ʎqɹɐǝu ɐ ᵷuᴉddɐʇ ʎq pꞁɹoʍ ǝɥʇ oʇuᴉ ʇᴉ ǝɔɐꞁd 'ɥɔɹoʇ ɐ ᵷuᴉpꞁoɥ ǝꞁᴉɥM

translation: ˙:ǝsn_ɹo_pꞁᴉnq_uoᴉʇɔɐ_uoʇʇnq_ꞁɐnʇɹᴉʌ_dᴉʇ: ᵷuᴉddɐʇ puɐ ʞɔoꞁq ʎqɹɐǝu ɐ ʇɐ ᵷuᴉɯᴉɐ ʎq pꞁɹoʍ ǝɥʇ oʇuᴉ ʇᴉ ǝɔɐꞁd 'ɥɔɹoʇ ɐ ᵷuᴉpꞁoɥ ǝꞁᴉɥM

source_string: There are several mobs in Minecraft that you can tame and make your pet. Each can be tamed by giving them an item that they like. Once tamed you can have them stay by pressing :_input_key.use: while looking at them.
translation: ˙ɯǝɥʇ ʇɐ ᵷuᴉʞooꞁ ǝꞁᴉɥʍ :ǝsn˙ʎǝʞ_ʇnduᴉ_: ᵷuᴉssǝɹd ʎq ʎɐʇs ɯǝɥʇ ǝʌɐɥ uɐɔ noʎ pǝɯɐʇ ǝɔuO ˙ǝʞᴉꞁ ʎǝɥʇ ʇɐɥʇ ɯǝʇᴉ uɐ ɯǝɥʇ ᵷuᴉʌᴉᵷ ʎq pǝɯɐʇ ǝq uɐɔ ɥɔɐƎ ˙ʇǝd ɹnoʎ ǝʞɐɯ puɐ ǝɯɐʇ uɐɔ noʎ ʇɐɥʇ ʇɟɐɹɔǝuᴉW uᴉ sqoɯ ꞁɐɹǝʌǝs ǝɹɐ ǝɹǝɥ⟘

source_string: There are several mobs in Minecraft that you can tame and make your pet. Each can be tamed by giving them an item that they like. Once tamed you can have them stay by tapping the Sit Button.
translation: ˙uoʇʇnᗺ ʇᴉS ǝɥʇ ᵷuᴉddɐʇ ʎq ʎɐʇs ɯǝɥʇ ǝʌɐɥ uɐɔ noʎ pǝɯɐʇ ǝɔuO ˙ǝʞᴉꞁ ʎǝɥʇ ʇɐɥʇ ɯǝʇᴉ uɐ ɯǝɥʇ ᵷuᴉʌᴉᵷ ʎq pǝɯɐʇ ǝq uɐɔ ɥɔɐƎ ˙ʇǝd ɹnoʎ ǝʞɐɯ puɐ ǝɯɐʇ uɐɔ noʎ ʇɐɥʇ ʇɟɐɹɔǝuᴉW uᴉ sqoɯ ꞁɐɹǝʌǝs ǝɹɐ ǝɹǝɥ⟘

source_string: Wolves are a neutral mob that hunt in the colder climates. They will attack Rabbits, Skeletons, and Sheep but run away from Llamas. They won't attack you unless you provoke them. You can tame them by giving them Bones.
translation: ˙sǝuoᗺ ɯǝɥʇ ᵷuᴉʌᴉᵷ ʎq ɯǝɥʇ ǝɯɐʇ uɐɔ no⅄ ˙ɯǝɥʇ ǝʞoʌoɹd noʎ ssǝꞁun noʎ ʞɔɐʇʇɐ ʇ,uoʍ ʎǝɥ⟘ ˙sɐɯɐꞁꞀ ɯoɹɟ ʎɐʍɐ unɹ ʇnq dǝǝɥS puɐ 'suoʇǝꞁǝʞS 'sʇᴉqqɐᴚ ʞɔɐʇʇɐ ꞁꞁᴉʍ ʎǝɥ⟘ ˙sǝʇɐɯᴉꞁɔ ɹǝpꞁoɔ ǝɥʇ uᴉ ʇunɥ ʇɐɥʇ qoɯ ꞁɐɹʇnǝu ɐ ǝɹɐ sǝʌꞁoM

source_string: Cats are a neutral mob that can be found in villages. They will attack Rabbits and Baby Turtles. They will also keep Phantoms and Creepers away. They will try to run from you so taming them can be tough. They like fish so give them Raw Cod or Salmon to tame them.
translation: ˙ɯǝɥʇ ǝɯɐʇ oʇ uoɯꞁɐS ɹo poƆ ʍɐᴚ ɯǝɥʇ ǝʌᴉᵷ os ɥsᴉɟ ǝʞᴉꞁ ʎǝɥ⟘ ˙ɥᵷnoʇ ǝq uɐɔ ɯǝɥʇ ᵷuᴉɯɐʇ os noʎ ɯoɹɟ unɹ oʇ ʎɹʇ ꞁꞁᴉʍ ʎǝɥ⟘ ˙ʎɐʍɐ sɹǝdǝǝɹƆ puɐ sɯoʇuɐɥԀ dǝǝʞ osꞁɐ ꞁꞁᴉʍ ʎǝɥ⟘ ˙sǝꞁʇɹn⟘ ʎqɐᗺ puɐ sʇᴉqqɐᴚ ʞɔɐʇʇɐ ꞁꞁᴉʍ ʎǝɥ⟘ ˙sǝᵷɐꞁꞁᴉʌ uᴉ punoɟ ǝq uɐɔ ʇɐɥʇ qoɯ ꞁɐɹʇnǝu ɐ ǝɹɐ sʇɐƆ

source_string: Parrots are a passive mob that live in the Jungle. They will imitate any other mob in the area. Seeds are their favorite, give them a few to tame them. Parrots will also sit on your shoulder... Yes, you can have more than one up there.
translation: ˙ǝɹǝɥʇ dn ǝuo uɐɥʇ ǝɹoɯ ǝʌɐɥ uɐɔ noʎ 'sǝ⅄ ˙˙˙ɹǝpꞁnoɥs ɹnoʎ uo ʇᴉs osꞁɐ ꞁꞁᴉʍ sʇoɹɹɐԀ ˙ɯǝɥʇ ǝɯɐʇ oʇ ʍǝɟ ɐ ɯǝɥʇ ǝʌᴉᵷ 'ǝʇᴉɹoʌɐɟ ɹᴉǝɥʇ ǝɹɐ spǝǝS ˙ɐǝɹɐ ǝɥʇ uᴉ qoɯ ɹǝɥʇo ʎuɐ ǝʇɐʇᴉɯᴉ ꞁꞁᴉʍ ʎǝɥ⟘ ˙ǝꞁᵷunՐ ǝɥʇ uᴉ ǝʌᴉꞁ ʇɐɥʇ qoɯ ǝʌᴉssɐd ɐ ǝɹɐ sʇoɹɹɐԀ

source_string: While exploring the world you may encounter a Pillager encampment or patrol. Pillagers are always looking for villages to raid. Taking their Banners will get their attention, and they may choose to attack a nearby village.
translation: ˙ǝᵷɐꞁꞁᴉʌ ʎqɹɐǝu ɐ ʞɔɐʇʇɐ oʇ ǝsooɥɔ ʎɐɯ ʎǝɥʇ puɐ 'uoᴉʇuǝʇʇɐ ɹᴉǝɥʇ ʇǝᵷ ꞁꞁᴉʍ sɹǝuuɐᗺ ɹᴉǝɥʇ ᵷuᴉʞɐ⟘ ˙pᴉɐɹ oʇ sǝᵷɐꞁꞁᴉʌ ɹoɟ ᵷuᴉʞooꞁ sʎɐʍꞁɐ ǝɹɐ sɹǝᵷɐꞁꞁᴉԀ ˙ꞁoɹʇɐd ɹo ʇuǝɯdɯɐɔuǝ ɹǝᵷɐꞁꞁᴉԀ ɐ ɹǝʇunoɔuǝ ʎɐɯ noʎ pꞁɹoʍ ǝɥʇ ᵷuᴉɹoꞁdxǝ ǝꞁᴉɥM

source_string: Be sure to defend your village, the attack will stop if you defeat all the raiders.
translation: ˙sɹǝpᴉɐɹ ǝɥʇ ꞁꞁɐ ʇɐǝɟǝp noʎ ɟᴉ doʇs ꞁꞁᴉʍ ʞɔɐʇʇɐ ǝɥʇ 'ǝᵷɐꞁꞁᴉʌ ɹnoʎ puǝɟǝp oʇ ǝɹns ǝᗺ

source_string: Villagers will most likely be very grateful that you have saved them from the raiders. Be sure to check back with them, you might get a good deal.
translation: ˙ꞁɐǝp pooᵷ ɐ ʇǝᵷ ʇɥᵷᴉɯ noʎ 'ɯǝɥʇ ɥʇᴉʍ ʞɔɐq ʞɔǝɥɔ oʇ ǝɹns ǝᗺ ˙sɹǝpᴉɐɹ ǝɥʇ ɯoɹɟ ɯǝɥʇ pǝʌɐs ǝʌɐɥ noʎ ʇɐɥʇ ꞁnɟǝʇɐɹᵷ ʎɹǝʌ ǝq ʎꞁǝʞᴉꞁ ʇsoɯ ꞁꞁᴉʍ sɹǝᵷɐꞁꞁᴉɅ

source_string: In Minecraft, you can have your own ranch filled with livestock! Ranching provides lots of resources such as wool, eggs, and raw meat.
translation: ˙ʇɐǝɯ ʍɐɹ puɐ 'sᵷᵷǝ 'ꞁooʍ sɐ ɥɔns sǝɔɹnosǝɹ ɟo sʇoꞁ sǝpᴉʌoɹd ᵷuᴉɥɔuɐᴚ ¡ʞɔoʇsǝʌᴉꞁ ɥʇᴉʍ pǝꞁꞁᴉɟ ɥɔuɐɹ uʍo ɹnoʎ ǝʌɐɥ uɐɔ noʎ 'ʇɟɐɹɔǝuᴉW uI

source_string: In order to keep your livestock growing, you have to make baby animals. Adult animals must enter Love Mode for this to happen. Feed the animals their preferred food to get them to enter Love Mode.
translation: ˙ǝpoW ǝʌoꞀ ɹǝʇuǝ oʇ ɯǝɥʇ ʇǝᵷ oʇ pooɟ pǝɹɹǝɟǝɹd ɹᴉǝɥʇ sꞁɐɯᴉuɐ ǝɥʇ pǝǝℲ ˙uǝddɐɥ oʇ sᴉɥʇ ɹoɟ ǝpoW ǝʌoꞀ ɹǝʇuǝ ʇsnɯ sꞁɐɯᴉuɐ ʇꞁnpⱯ ˙sꞁɐɯᴉuɐ ʎqɐq ǝʞɐɯ oʇ ǝʌɐɥ noʎ 'ᵷuᴉʍoɹᵷ ʞɔoʇsǝʌᴉꞁ ɹnoʎ dǝǝʞ oʇ ɹǝpɹo uI

source_string: When two like animals are nearby and in Love Mode, they will kiss for a moment and then a baby animal will appear! The baby animal will stay with their parents until they grow into an adult. After having a baby, adult animals must wait 1 minute before entering Love Mode.

When you attempt to place too many scaffolding blocks without proper support, it will fall. Scaffolding can be placed like normal blocks, but it can also be placed on its own foundation to quickly build a tall tower.

source_string: Redstone can be used to activate a Structure Block. This will cause it to either save a structure out or load a structure into the world, depending on the mode of the block and its settings.
translation: ˙sᵷuᴉʇʇǝs sʇᴉ puɐ ʞɔoꞁq ǝɥʇ ɟo ǝpoɯ ǝɥʇ uo ᵷuᴉpuǝdǝp 'pꞁɹoʍ ǝɥʇ oʇuᴉ ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇs ɐ pɐoꞁ ɹo ʇno ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇs ɐ ǝʌɐs ɹǝɥʇᴉǝ oʇ ʇᴉ ǝsnɐɔ ꞁꞁᴉʍ sᴉɥ⟘ ˙ʞɔoꞁᗺ ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇS ɐ ǝʇɐʌᴉʇɔɐ oʇ pǝsn ǝq uɐɔ ǝuoʇspǝᴚ

source_string: You can change how much of a structure is loaded in by changing the values for Integrity and Seed.
translation: ˙pǝǝS puɐ ʎʇᴉɹᵷǝʇuI ɹoɟ sǝnꞁɐʌ ǝɥʇ ᵷuᴉᵷuɐɥɔ ʎq uᴉ pǝpɐoꞁ sᴉ ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇs ɐ ɟo ɥɔnɯ ʍoɥ ǝᵷuɐɥɔ uɐɔ no⅄

source_string: Integrity - the percentage of blocks to load in from the structure, accepted values are 0 to 100. Blocks will be chosen randomly if a Seed is not specified.
translation: ˙pǝᴉɟᴉɔǝds ʇou sᴉ pǝǝS ɐ ɟᴉ ʎꞁɯopuɐɹ uǝsoɥɔ ǝq ꞁꞁᴉʍ sʞɔoꞁᗺ ˙001 oʇ 0 ǝɹɐ sǝnꞁɐʌ pǝʇdǝɔɔɐ 'ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇs ǝɥʇ ɯoɹɟ uᴉ pɐoꞁ oʇ sʞɔoꞁq ɟo ǝᵷɐʇuǝɔɹǝd ǝɥʇ - ʎʇᴉɹᵷǝʇuI

source_string: Seed - the value entered here will determine which blocks to remove when using Integrity. Leave this field blank if you want the blocks to be chosen randomly.
translation: ˙ʎꞁɯopuɐɹ uǝsoɥɔ ǝq oʇ sʞɔoꞁq ǝɥʇ ʇuɐʍ noʎ ɟᴉ ʞuɐꞁq pꞁǝᴉɟ sᴉɥʇ ǝʌɐǝꞀ ˙ʎʇᴉɹᵷǝʇuI ᵷuᴉsn uǝɥʍ ǝʌoɯǝɹ oʇ sʞɔoꞁq ɥɔᴉɥʍ ǝuᴉɯɹǝʇǝp ꞁꞁᴉʍ ǝɹǝɥ pǝɹǝʇuǝ ǝnꞁɐʌ ǝɥʇ - pǝǝS

source_string: When a structure with Structure Void blocks is loaded into the world, any block that would have been removed where the structure void block is loading into, will instead stay in the world.
translation: ˙pꞁɹoʍ ǝɥʇ uᴉ ʎɐʇs pɐǝʇsuᴉ ꞁꞁᴉʍ 'oʇuᴉ ᵷuᴉpɐoꞁ sᴉ ʞɔoꞁq pᴉoʌ ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇs ǝɥʇ ǝɹǝɥʍ pǝʌoɯǝɹ uǝǝq ǝʌɐɥ pꞁnoʍ ʇɐɥʇ ʞɔoꞁq ʎuɐ 'pꞁɹoʍ ǝɥʇ oʇuᴉ pǝpɐoꞁ sᴉ sʞɔoꞁq pᴉoɅ ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇS ɥʇᴉʍ ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇs ɐ uǝɥM

source_string: Example: loading an empty shipwreck into the bottom of the ocean will normally copy air over the water blocks. If the shipwreck was filled with structure void, then the water will stay, and you will have a shipwreck filled with water.
translation: ˙ɹǝʇɐʍ ɥʇᴉʍ pǝꞁꞁᴉɟ ʞɔǝɹʍdᴉɥs ɐ ǝʌɐɥ ꞁꞁᴉʍ noʎ puɐ 'ʎɐʇs ꞁꞁᴉʍ ɹǝʇɐʍ ǝɥʇ uǝɥʇ 'pᴉoʌ ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇs ɥʇᴉʍ pǝꞁꞁᴉɟ sɐʍ ʞɔǝɹʍdᴉɥs ǝɥʇ ɟI ˙sʞɔoꞁq ɹǝʇɐʍ ǝɥʇ ɹǝʌo ɹᴉɐ ʎdoɔ ʎꞁꞁɐɯɹou ꞁꞁᴉʍ uɐǝɔo ǝɥʇ ɟo ɯoʇʇoq ǝɥʇ oʇuᴉ ʞɔǝɹʍdᴉɥs ʎʇdɯǝ uɐ ᵷuᴉpɐoꞁ :ǝꞁdɯɐxƎ

source_string: To automatically select the area you want to save, you can place Corner Mode blocks around your structure and name them with the same name as the structure you want to save.
translation: ˙ǝʌɐs oʇ ʇuɐʍ noʎ ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇs ǝɥʇ sɐ ǝɯɐu ǝɯɐs ǝɥʇ ɥʇᴉʍ ɯǝɥʇ ǝɯɐu puɐ ǝɹnʇɔnɹʇs ɹnoʎ punoɹɐ sʞɔoꞁq ǝpoW ɹǝuɹoƆ ǝɔɐꞁd uɐɔ noʎ 'ǝʌɐs oʇ ʇuɐʍ noʎ ɐǝɹɐ ǝɥʇ ʇɔǝꞁǝs ʎꞁꞁɐɔᴉʇɐɯoʇnɐ o⟘

source_string: Pressing the Detect button in Save mode will find all of the Corner Blocks with the same name and create a selection area so that it will save everything inside of the volume those Corner Blocks make.
translation: ˙ǝʞɐɯ sʞɔoꞁᗺ ɹǝuɹoƆ ǝsoɥʇ ǝɯnꞁoʌ ǝɥʇ ɟo ǝpᴉsuᴉ ᵷuᴉɥʇʎɹǝʌǝ ǝʌɐs ꞁꞁᴉʍ ʇᴉ ʇɐɥʇ os ɐǝɹɐ uoᴉʇɔǝꞁǝs ɐ ǝʇɐǝɹɔ puɐ ǝɯɐu ǝɯɐs ǝɥʇ ɥʇᴉʍ sʞɔoꞁᗺ ɹǝuɹoƆ ǝɥʇ ɟo ꞁꞁɐ puᴉɟ ꞁꞁᴉʍ ǝpoɯ ǝʌɐS uᴉ uoʇʇnq ʇɔǝʇǝᗡ ǝɥʇ ᵷuᴉssǝɹԀ

translation: ˙ʇuɐʍ noʎ ɹǝʌǝuǝɥʍ ǝɹǝɥ ʎɐꞁd uɐɔ spuǝᴉɹɟ ɹnoʎ puɐ noʎ os 'ǝuᴉꞁuo sʎɐʍꞁɐ sᴉ ɯꞁɐǝᴚ Ɐ

source_string: Check the Timeline in Realms Stories to find out when others are playing.

source_string: Bored of gravity? Jump twice to fly!
context: A fun way to tell players that they can fly if they press the jump button twice.{MaxLength="200"}

translation: ˙ɔᴉsnɯ ɥʇᴉʍ pꞁɹoʍ ǝɥʇ ꞁꞁᴉɟ puɐ suɹoɥ ʇɐoᵷ ʇɔǝꞁꞁoƆ

translation: ˙sʇꞁnsǝɹ ǝʌᴉsoꞁdxǝ ɹoɟ ʞɔoꞁq ⟘N⟘ ɐ ɥʇᴉʍ ꞁǝǝʇs puɐ ʇuᴉꞁɟ ǝuᴉqɯoƆ

translation: ¡ʎzzᴉp ʇǝᵷ ʇ,uoᗡ ˙ꞁɹɐǝd ɹǝpuǝ uɐ ɥʇᴉʍ dɐɯ ǝɥʇ punoɹɐ ᵷuᴉʞuᴉꞁq ʎɹ⟘
context: An ender pearl is an item that can be thrown and teleports the thrower to where it lands.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Use rails and a minecart to build the perfect transport system. Or rollercoaster!
translation: ¡ɹǝʇsɐoɔɹǝꞁꞁoɹ ɹO ˙ɯǝʇsʎs ʇɹodsuɐɹʇ ʇɔǝɟɹǝd ǝɥʇ pꞁᴉnq oʇ ʇɹɐɔǝuᴉɯ ɐ puɐ sꞁᴉɐɹ ǝs∩

context: In the Game mode Survival mode you can die. In Creative you can’t.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.

context: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: You can't die, but villagers can. Use that information... wisely.
translation: ˙ʎꞁǝsᴉʍ ˙˙˙uoᴉʇɐɯɹoɟuᴉ ʇɐɥʇ ǝs∩ ˙uɐɔ sɹǝᵷɐꞁꞁᴉʌ ʇnq 'ǝᴉp ʇ,uɐɔ no⅄
context: This means you can do things that will get villagers killed. Like attracting monsters to the village.{MaxLength="200"}

translation: ¿ɹǝʇʇǝq op uɐɔ noʎ ʞuᴉɥ⟘ ˙sǝᵷɐꞁꞁᴉʌ ᵷuᴉpꞁᴉnq ʇɐ ʇɐǝɹᵷ ǝɹɐ sɹǝᵷɐꞁꞁᴉɅ
context: This is a prompt to encourage players to build things.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Wolves will attack skeletons to chew on their tasty bones.
translation: ˙sǝuoq ʎʇsɐʇ ɹᴉǝɥʇ uo ʍǝɥɔ oʇ suoʇǝꞁǝʞs ʞɔɐʇʇɐ ꞁꞁᴉʍ sǝʌꞁoM
context: Wolves will attack skeletons. It’s also a discrete hint that you should feel wolves with bones to tame them.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Tame wild horses by sitting on them until they're calm, then saddle up and ride off. (Note: Horses do not work like that outside of Minecraft.)
translation: (˙ʇɟɐɹɔǝuᴉW ɟo ǝpᴉsʇno ʇɐɥʇ ǝʞᴉꞁ ʞɹoʍ ʇou op sǝsɹoH :ǝʇoN) ˙ɟɟo ǝpᴉɹ puɐ dn ǝꞁppɐs uǝɥʇ 'ɯꞁɐɔ ǝɹ,ʎǝɥʇ ꞁᴉʇun ɯǝɥʇ uo ᵷuᴉʇʇᴉs ʎq sǝsɹoɥ pꞁᴉʍ ǝɯɐ⟘
context: It’s a bit unintuitive how you tame horses. Most other animals are tamed by feeding them. Not Horses. {MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Eat as much as you want, you'll never get full! And you'll never starve.
translation: ˙ǝʌɹɐʇs ɹǝʌǝu ꞁꞁ,noʎ puⱯ ¡ꞁꞁnɟ ʇǝᵷ ɹǝʌǝu ꞁꞁ,noʎ 'ʇuɐʍ noʎ sɐ ɥɔnɯ sɐ ʇɐƎ
context: In Creative Mode you don’t get hungry. Eating the food it just for fun.{MaxLength="200"}

context: There is a Game mode called Spectator Mode. It allows you to fly through walls and blocks and everything.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Who needs tools? Punch your way to success and remove blocks instantly in creative mode.
translation: ˙ǝpoɯ ǝʌᴉʇɐǝɹɔ uᴉ ʎꞁʇuɐʇsuᴉ sʞɔoꞁq ǝʌoɯǝɹ puɐ ssǝɔɔns oʇ ʎɐʍ ɹnoʎ ɥɔunԀ ¿sꞁooʇ spǝǝu oɥM
context: Block breaking happens very fast when you’re in Creative Mode.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Like what you see? Use the pick block button to start building with whatever you're looking at. Yes, even mobs!
translation: ¡sqoɯ uǝʌǝ 'sǝ⅄ ˙ʇɐ ᵷuᴉʞooꞁ ǝɹ,noʎ ɹǝʌǝʇɐɥʍ ɥʇᴉʍ ᵷuᴉpꞁᴉnq ʇɹɐʇs oʇ uoʇʇnq ʞɔoꞁq ʞɔᴉd ǝɥʇ ǝs∩ ¿ǝǝs noʎ ʇɐɥʍ ǝʞᴉꞀ
context: There is a feature called “Pick block” that enables players to instantly equip any block they click on. If you click on a mob(animal or monster) you will get a spawn egg that summons another monster/animal of that kind.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Get there now with the /tp command.
translation: ˙puɐɯɯoɔ dʇ/ ǝɥʇ ɥʇᴉʍ ʍou ǝɹǝɥʇ ʇǝ⅁
context: You can teleport yourself in Creative. You use the /tp command in the chat.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Mobs won't notice you in creative mode, but they'll still notice each other…
translation: …ɹǝɥʇo ɥɔɐǝ ǝɔᴉʇou ꞁꞁᴉʇs ꞁꞁ,ʎǝɥʇ ʇnq 'ǝpoɯ ǝʌᴉʇɐǝɹɔ uᴉ noʎ ǝɔᴉʇou ʇ,uoʍ sqoW
context: Mobs(animals & monsters) won’t notice you in creative mode, but they’ll still notice each other… meaning that they can still kill each other.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: A warden a day keeps the… well, everything away.
translation: ˙ʎɐʍɐ ᵷuᴉɥʇʎɹǝʌǝ 'ꞁꞁǝʍ …ǝɥʇ sdǝǝʞ ʎɐp ɐ uǝpɹɐʍ Ɐ
context: The Warden is a scary monster that live in underground cities.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Why not build an underwater base? It's not like you can drown.

context: You can’t drown in creative mode. So it’s possible to build underwater without danger.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Whatever you can dream, you can build. There's no limit to your resources (in creative mode...).
translation: ˙(˙˙˙ǝpoɯ ǝʌᴉʇɐǝɹɔ uᴉ) sǝɔɹnosǝɹ ɹnoʎ oʇ ʇᴉɯᴉꞁ ou s,ǝɹǝɥ⟘ ˙pꞁᴉnq uɐɔ noʎ 'ɯɐǝɹp uɐɔ noʎ ɹǝʌǝʇɐɥM
context: Players have endless resources in Creative mode. They get all the building blocks from their inventory.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Phantoms can't hurt you, but you can still shoo them off by using a bed. Just...not literally. You sleep in it.
translation: ˙ʇᴉ uᴉ dǝǝꞁs no⅄ ˙ʎꞁꞁɐɹǝʇᴉꞁ ʇou˙˙˙ʇsnՐ ˙pǝq ɐ ᵷuᴉsn ʎq ɟɟo ɯǝɥʇ ooɥs ꞁꞁᴉʇs uɐɔ noʎ ʇnq 'noʎ ʇɹnɥ ʇ,uɐɔ sɯoʇuɐɥԀ
context: Phantoms are flying mobs(monsters) that spawn when you havn't slept for a few days. They won't hurt you in Creative Mode. To get rid of them you sleep in a bed.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Have you tried swimming in lava? It's like sinking into a warm bath. Just don't try it in survival mode...

context: Lava doesn't hurt you in creative mode.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: You must watch your hunger level while adventuring, your hunger level is represented on your HUD with :shank:. The hunger level decreases as you explore. Certain activities will decrease hunger level at a faster rate, such as sprinting. You can replenish your hunger level by eating food. Some foods are more nourishing than others and will fill up more :shank:. When you get your hunger level up to maximum, the last food you ate applies a saturation value. Saturation is a hidden number that gives you an extra bonus to your hunger level.

translation: ǝᵷɐɯᴉ ǝɥʇ ɟo ʎʇᴉsuǝʇuᴉ ǝɔuɐuᴉɯnꞁ ꞁꞁɐɹǝʌo ǝɥʇ ʇsnɾpɐ oʇ ꞁǝuuɐɥɔ ɹoꞁoɔ uǝʌᴉᵷ ɐ oʇ pǝppɐ uǝɥʇ puɐ ǝuǝɔs ǝɥʇ ɟo ǝɔuɐuᴉɯnꞁ ǝᵷɐɹǝʌɐ ǝɥʇ ʎq pǝᴉꞁdᴉʇꞁnɯ sᴉ ʇɐɥʇ ɹoʇɔɐɟ ǝʌᴉʇᴉppɐ uɐ sᴉ ʇǝsɟɟO

source_string: Gain is a multiplication factor applied to each color channel to adjust the overall luminance intensity of the image
translation: ǝᵷɐɯᴉ ǝɥʇ ɟo ʎʇᴉsuǝʇuᴉ ǝɔuɐuᴉɯnꞁ ꞁꞁɐɹǝʌo ǝɥʇ ʇsnɾpɐ oʇ ꞁǝuuɐɥɔ ɹoꞁoɔ ɥɔɐǝ oʇ pǝᴉꞁddɐ ɹoʇɔɐɟ uoᴉʇɐɔᴉꞁdᴉʇꞁnɯ ɐ sᴉ uᴉɐ⅁

source_string: Gamma is an exponential factor applied to the final color after both color grading and tone mapping to adjust the overall luminance intensity of the image
translation: ǝᵷɐɯᴉ ǝɥʇ ɟo ʎʇᴉsuǝʇuᴉ ǝɔuɐuᴉɯnꞁ ꞁꞁɐɹǝʌo ǝɥʇ ʇsnɾpɐ oʇ ᵷuᴉddɐɯ ǝuoʇ puɐ ᵷuᴉpɐɹᵷ ɹoꞁoɔ ɥʇoq ɹǝʇɟɐ ɹoꞁoɔ ꞁɐuᴉɟ ǝɥʇ oʇ pǝᴉꞁddɐ ɹoʇɔɐɟ ꞁɐᴉʇuǝuodxǝ uɐ sᴉ ɐɯɯɐ⅁

source_string: Offset is an additive factor that is multiplied by the average luminance of the scene and then added to a given color channel to adjust the overall luminance intensity of the image
translation: ǝᵷɐɯᴉ ǝɥʇ ɟo ʎʇᴉsuǝʇuᴉ ǝɔuɐuᴉɯnꞁ ꞁꞁɐɹǝʌo ǝɥʇ ʇsnɾpɐ oʇ ꞁǝuuɐɥɔ ɹoꞁoɔ uǝʌᴉᵷ ɐ oʇ pǝppɐ uǝɥʇ puɐ ǝuǝɔs ǝɥʇ ɟo ǝɔuɐuᴉɯnꞁ ǝᵷɐɹǝʌɐ ǝɥʇ ʎq pǝᴉꞁdᴉʇꞁnɯ sᴉ ʇɐɥʇ ɹoʇɔɐɟ ǝʌᴉʇᴉppɐ uɐ sᴉ ʇǝsɟɟO

source_string: Saturation determines the hue intensity of colors
translation: sɹoꞁoɔ ɟo ʎʇᴉsuǝʇuᴉ ǝnɥ ǝɥʇ sǝuᴉɯɹǝʇǝp uoᴉʇɐɹnʇɐS

The composition of particles in a body of water is what determines its color and how light behaves as it travels through the water. There are 3 types of particles: CDOM, Chlorophyll, and Suspended Sediment
translation: ʇuǝɯᴉpǝS pǝpuǝdsnS puɐ 'ꞁꞁʎɥdoɹoꞁɥƆ 'WOᗡƆ :sǝꞁɔᴉʇɹɐd ɟo sǝdʎʇ 3 ǝɹɐ ǝɹǝɥ⟘ ˙ɹǝʇɐʍ ǝɥʇ ɥᵷnoɹɥʇ sꞁǝʌɐɹʇ ʇᴉ sɐ sǝʌɐɥǝq ʇɥᵷᴉꞁ ʍoɥ puɐ ɹoꞁoɔ sʇᴉ sǝuᴉɯɹǝʇǝp ʇɐɥʍ sᴉ ɹǝʇɐʍ ɟo ʎpoq ɐ uᴉ sǝꞁɔᴉʇɹɐd ɟo uoᴉʇᴉsodɯoɔ ǝɥ⟘

translation: sɥʇᵷuǝꞁǝʌɐʍ pǝɹ puɐ ǝnꞁq ᵷuᴉqɹosqɐ ʎꞁᵷuoɹʇs ꞁꞁʎɥdoɹoꞁɥɔ oʇ ǝnp 'sɹoꞁoɔ uǝǝɹᵷ sǝɔnpoɹd ꞁꞁʎɥdoɹoꞁɥɔ ɟo suoᴉʇɐɹʇuǝɔuoɔ ɥᵷᴉH

source_string: High concentrations of suspended sediment produces red to red-brown colors, due to suspended sediment strongly absorbing blue and green wavelengths
translation: sɥʇᵷuǝꞁǝʌɐʍ uǝǝɹᵷ puɐ ǝnꞁq ᵷuᴉqɹosqɐ ʎꞁᵷuoɹʇs ʇuǝɯᴉpǝs pǝpuǝdsns oʇ ǝnp 'sɹoꞁoɔ uʍoɹq-pǝɹ oʇ pǝɹ sǝɔnpoɹd ʇuǝɯᴉpǝs pǝpuǝdsns ɟo suoᴉʇɐɹʇuǝɔuoɔ ɥᵷᴉH

source_string: Frame Length The number of seconds to spend on a single frame of animation in the caustics sprite sheet texture. A larger value will result in a slower animation, while smaller values will result in a faster animation
translation: uoᴉʇɐɯᴉuɐ ɹǝʇsɐɟ ɐ uᴉ ʇꞁnsǝɹ ꞁꞁᴉʍ sǝnꞁɐʌ ɹǝꞁꞁɐɯs ǝꞁᴉɥʍ 'uoᴉʇɐɯᴉuɐ ɹǝʍoꞁs ɐ uᴉ ʇꞁnsǝɹ ꞁꞁᴉʍ ǝnꞁɐʌ ɹǝᵷɹɐꞁ Ɐ ˙ǝɹnʇxǝʇ ʇǝǝɥs ǝʇᴉɹds sɔᴉʇsnɐɔ ǝɥʇ uᴉ uoᴉʇɐɯᴉuɐ ɟo ǝɯɐɹɟ ǝꞁᵷuᴉs ɐ uo puǝds oʇ spuoɔǝs ɟo ɹǝqɯnu ǝɥ⟘ ɥʇᵷuǝꞀ ǝɯɐɹℲ

translation: uoᴉʇɐɯᴉuɐ sɔᴉʇsnɐɔ ǝɥʇ ɹoɟ ǝsn oʇ ǝɹnʇxǝʇ ɐ sǝᴉɟᴉɔǝdS

source_string: Controls the size of the caustics texture when it is projected on the world. This value scales inversely in that, a larger value means that the texture will appear smaller, repeating/tiling more, whereas a smaller value will cause the texture to appear bigger, covering a larger area of the world
translation: pꞁɹoʍ ǝɥʇ ɟo ɐǝɹɐ ɹǝᵷɹɐꞁ ɐ ᵷuᴉɹǝʌoɔ 'ɹǝᵷᵷᴉq ɹɐǝddɐ oʇ ǝɹnʇxǝʇ ǝɥʇ ǝsnɐɔ ꞁꞁᴉʍ ǝnꞁɐʌ ɹǝꞁꞁɐɯs ɐ sɐǝɹǝɥʍ 'ǝɹoɯ ᵷuᴉꞁᴉʇ/ᵷuᴉʇɐǝdǝɹ 'ɹǝꞁꞁɐɯs ɹɐǝddɐ ꞁꞁᴉʍ ǝɹnʇxǝʇ ǝɥʇ ʇɐɥʇ suɐǝɯ ǝnꞁɐʌ ɹǝᵷɹɐꞁ ɐ 'ʇɐɥʇ uᴉ ʎꞁǝsɹǝʌuᴉ sǝꞁɐɔs ǝnꞁɐʌ sᴉɥ⟘ ˙pꞁɹoʍ ǝɥʇ uo pǝʇɔǝɾoɹd sᴉ ʇᴉ uǝɥʍ ǝɹnʇxǝʇ sɔᴉʇsnɐɔ ǝɥʇ ɟo ǝzᴉs ǝɥʇ sꞁoɹʇuoƆ

translation: ʎʇᴉsuǝʇuᴉ/ssǝuʇɥᵷᴉɹq ǝɥʇ ǝsɐǝɹɔuᴉ ꞁꞁᴉʍ ǝnꞁɐʌ ɹǝᵷɹɐꞁ Ɐ ˙sɹɐǝddɐ ʇɔǝɟɟǝ sɔᴉʇsnɐɔ ǝɥʇ ʇɥᵷᴉɹq ʍoɥ sꞁoɹʇuoƆ

source_string: Waves are an optional effect that can be used to complement water surface animations to make your water appear more realistic. They can be configured to blend with existing water texture animations or replace them entirely
translation: ʎꞁǝɹᴉʇuǝ ɯǝɥʇ ǝɔɐꞁdǝɹ ɹo suoᴉʇɐɯᴉuɐ ǝɹnʇxǝʇ ɹǝʇɐʍ ᵷuᴉʇsᴉxǝ ɥʇᴉʍ puǝꞁq oʇ pǝɹnᵷᴉɟuoɔ ǝq uɐɔ ʎǝɥ⟘ ˙ɔᴉʇsᴉꞁɐǝɹ ǝɹoɯ ɹɐǝddɐ ɹǝʇɐʍ ɹnoʎ ǝʞɐɯ oʇ suoᴉʇɐɯᴉuɐ ǝɔɐɟɹns ɹǝʇɐʍ ʇuǝɯǝꞁdɯoɔ oʇ pǝsn ǝq uɐɔ ʇɐɥʇ ʇɔǝɟɟǝ ꞁɐuoᴉʇdo uɐ ǝɹɐ sǝʌɐM

source_string: Determines how many waves there are per water block. Larger values will create more tightly packed waves, whereas smaller values will spread waves out over a wider area
translation: ɐǝɹɐ ɹǝpᴉʍ ɐ ɹǝʌo ʇno sǝʌɐʍ pɐǝɹds ꞁꞁᴉʍ sǝnꞁɐʌ ɹǝꞁꞁɐɯs sɐǝɹǝɥʍ 'sǝʌɐʍ pǝʞɔɐd ʎꞁʇɥᵷᴉʇ ǝɹoɯ ǝʇɐǝɹɔ ꞁꞁᴉʍ sǝnꞁɐʌ ɹǝᵷɹɐꞀ ˙ʞɔoꞁq ɹǝʇɐʍ ɹǝd ǝɹɐ ǝɹǝɥʇ sǝʌɐʍ ʎuɐɯ ʍoɥ sǝuᴉɯɹǝʇǝᗡ

source_string: Determines how many different layers of waves to simulate. Larger values will produce more complex waves
translation: sǝʌɐʍ xǝꞁdɯoɔ ǝɹoɯ ǝɔnpoɹd ꞁꞁᴉʍ sǝnꞁɐʌ ɹǝᵷɹɐꞀ ˙ǝʇɐꞁnɯᴉs oʇ sǝʌɐʍ ɟo sɹǝʎɐꞁ ʇuǝɹǝɟɟᴉp ʎuɐɯ ʍoɥ sǝuᴉɯɹǝʇǝᗡ

source_string: Determines how much waves displace the water surface. Larger values will result in deeper waves, whereas smaller values will produce shallower waves
translation: sǝʌɐʍ ɹǝʍoꞁꞁɐɥs ǝɔnpoɹd ꞁꞁᴉʍ sǝnꞁɐʌ ɹǝꞁꞁɐɯs sɐǝɹǝɥʍ 'sǝʌɐʍ ɹǝdǝǝp uᴉ ʇꞁnsǝɹ ꞁꞁᴉʍ sǝnꞁɐʌ ɹǝᵷɹɐꞀ ˙ǝɔɐɟɹns ɹǝʇɐʍ ǝɥʇ ǝɔɐꞁdsᴉp sǝʌɐʍ ɥɔnɯ ʍoɥ sǝuᴉɯɹǝʇǝᗡ

source_string: Controls the overall resolution of the fractal effect. A value of 1 represents the lowest resolution, resulting in smoother waves, while values less than 1 produce more chaotic waves
translation: sǝʌɐʍ ɔᴉʇoɐɥɔ ǝɹoɯ ǝɔnpoɹd 1 uɐɥʇ ssǝꞁ sǝnꞁɐʌ ǝꞁᴉɥʍ 'sǝʌɐʍ ɹǝɥʇooɯs uᴉ ᵷuᴉʇꞁnsǝɹ 'uoᴉʇnꞁosǝɹ ʇsǝʍoꞁ ǝɥʇ sʇuǝsǝɹdǝɹ 1 ɟo ǝnꞁɐʌ Ɐ ˙ʇɔǝɟɟǝ ꞁɐʇɔɐɹɟ ǝɥʇ ɟo uoᴉʇnꞁosǝɹ ꞁꞁɐɹǝʌo ǝɥʇ sꞁoɹʇuoƆ

source_string: Determines the movement speed of the first wave and the starting value of the Speed Scaling parameter
translation: ɹǝʇǝɯɐɹɐd ᵷuᴉꞁɐɔS pǝǝdS ǝɥʇ ɟo ǝnꞁɐʌ ᵷuᴉʇɹɐʇs ǝɥʇ puɐ ǝʌɐʍ ʇsɹᴉɟ ǝɥʇ ɟo pǝǝds ʇuǝɯǝʌoɯ ǝɥʇ sǝuᴉɯɹǝʇǝᗡ

source_string: Adjusts the core shape of waves. A value of 1 results in a pure sine wave, whereas values larger than 1 will produce sharper waves
translation: sǝʌɐʍ ɹǝdɹɐɥs ǝɔnpoɹd ꞁꞁᴉʍ 1 uɐɥʇ ɹǝᵷɹɐꞁ sǝnꞁɐʌ sɐǝɹǝɥʍ 'ǝʌɐʍ ǝuᴉs ǝɹnd ɐ uᴉ sʇꞁnsǝɹ 1 ɟo ǝnꞁɐʌ Ɐ ˙sǝʌɐʍ ɟo ǝdɐɥs ǝɹoɔ ǝɥʇ sʇsnɾpⱯ

source_string: %s Use "Import Custom Mesh" to choose a 3D mesh on your hard drive that you've downloaded or exported from a modeling program.%s You can move, rotate and scale the mesh preview in your world using the viewport widget and the sliders in the tool panel.%s "Place Blocks" will turn your mesh into a shell of blocks using your active hotbar selection.%s "Cancel" will clear the loaded mesh
translation: ɥsǝɯ pǝpɐoꞁ ǝɥʇ ɹɐǝꞁɔ ꞁꞁᴉʍ "ꞁǝɔuɐƆ" %4$s˙uoᴉʇɔǝꞁǝs ɹɐqʇoɥ ǝʌᴉʇɔɐ ɹnoʎ ᵷuᴉsn sʞɔoꞁq ɟo ꞁꞁǝɥs ɐ oʇuᴉ ɥsǝɯ ɹnoʎ uɹnʇ ꞁꞁᴉʍ "sʞɔoꞁᗺ ǝɔɐꞁԀ" %3$s˙ꞁǝuɐd ꞁooʇ ǝɥʇ uᴉ sɹǝpᴉꞁs ǝɥʇ puɐ ʇǝᵷpᴉʍ ʇɹodʍǝᴉʌ ǝɥʇ ᵷuᴉsn pꞁɹoʍ ɹnoʎ uᴉ ʍǝᴉʌǝɹd ɥsǝɯ ǝɥʇ ǝꞁɐɔs puɐ ǝʇɐʇoɹ 'ǝʌoɯ uɐɔ no⅄ %2$s˙ɯɐɹᵷoɹd ᵷuᴉꞁǝpoɯ ɐ ɯoɹɟ pǝʇɹodxǝ ɹo pǝpɐoꞁuʍop ǝʌ,noʎ ʇɐɥʇ ǝʌᴉɹp pɹɐɥ ɹnoʎ uo ɥsǝɯ ᗡ3 ɐ ǝsooɥɔ oʇ "ɥsǝW ɯoʇsnƆ ʇɹodɯI" ǝs∩ %1$s

source_string: %s Add your own Custom Dimensions with the "Add Custom Dimension" button.%s Dimension names must include a namespace, such as "namespace:mydimension".%s Click on any dimension in the list to visit it and start placing blocks. You can also find them in the World/Dimensions menu.%s Custom dimensions cannot currently be renamed or deleted.
translation: ˙pǝʇǝꞁǝp ɹo pǝɯɐuǝɹ ǝq ʎꞁʇuǝɹɹnɔ ʇouuɐɔ suoᴉsuǝɯᴉp ɯoʇsnƆ %4$s˙nuǝɯ suoᴉsuǝɯᴉᗡ/pꞁɹoM ǝɥʇ uᴉ ɯǝɥʇ puᴉɟ osꞁɐ uɐɔ no⅄ ˙sʞɔoꞁq ᵷuᴉɔɐꞁd ʇɹɐʇs puɐ ʇᴉ ʇᴉsᴉʌ oʇ ʇsᴉꞁ ǝɥʇ uᴉ uoᴉsuǝɯᴉp ʎuɐ uo ʞɔᴉꞁƆ %3$s˙"uoᴉsuǝɯᴉpʎɯ:ǝɔɐdsǝɯɐu" sɐ ɥɔns 'ǝɔɐdsǝɯɐu ɐ ǝpnꞁɔuᴉ ʇsnɯ sǝɯɐu uoᴉsuǝɯᴉᗡ %2$s˙uoʇʇnq "uoᴉsuǝɯᴉᗡ ɯoʇsnƆ ppⱯ" ǝɥʇ ɥʇᴉʍ suoᴉsuǝɯᴉᗡ ɯoʇsnƆ uʍo ɹnoʎ ppⱯ %1$s

source_string: %s Biome Data Assignment lets you assign a selection to the biome of your choice.%s This does not add or change any blocks, but will affect game systems like vegetation tint, mob spawning, Vibrant Visuals, and weather.%s Choose a biome in the "Biome to Assign" box, and use the "Assign Biome to Selection" to reassign data.
translation: ˙ɐʇɐp uᵷᴉssɐǝɹ oʇ "uoᴉʇɔǝꞁǝS oʇ ǝɯoᴉᗺ uᵷᴉssⱯ" ǝɥʇ ǝsn puɐ 'xoq "uᵷᴉssⱯ oʇ ǝɯoᴉᗺ" ǝɥʇ uᴉ ǝɯoᴉq ɐ ǝsooɥƆ %3$s˙ɹǝɥʇɐǝʍ puɐ 'sꞁɐnsᴉɅ ʇuɐɹqᴉɅ 'ᵷuᴉuʍɐds qoɯ 'ʇuᴉʇ uoᴉʇɐʇǝᵷǝʌ ǝʞᴉꞁ sɯǝʇsʎs ǝɯɐᵷ ʇɔǝɟɟɐ ꞁꞁᴉʍ ʇnq 'sʞɔoꞁq ʎuɐ ǝᵷuɐɥɔ ɹo ppɐ ʇou sǝop sᴉɥ⟘ %2$s˙ǝɔᴉoɥɔ ɹnoʎ ɟo ǝɯoᴉq ǝɥʇ oʇ uoᴉʇɔǝꞁǝs ɐ uᵷᴉssɐ noʎ sʇǝꞁ ʇuǝɯuᵷᴉssⱯ ɐʇɐᗡ ǝɯoᴉᗺ %1$s

source_string: %s You'll be reassigning a selection in the world. Within the Biome Data Assignment panel, you can use additional settings to determine how the data reassignment will interact with that selection.%s "Extend up to world ceiling" and "Extend down to world floor" will extend the effect on the Y axis, including all blocks above or below your selection respectively.%s Masking your selection by Biomes or Biome Tags will use existing Biome boundaries to restrict the effect further. These settings will not extend data assignment beyond your selection, but can provide further control.%s By default, the list of available biomes and tags will be filtered to show only valid options within your existing selection. Uncheck "Only show biomes/tags within the active selection" to see the full list.
translation: ˙ʇsᴉꞁ ꞁꞁnɟ ǝɥʇ ǝǝs oʇ "uoᴉʇɔǝꞁǝs ǝʌᴉʇɔɐ ǝɥʇ uᴉɥʇᴉʍ sᵷɐʇ/sǝɯoᴉq ʍoɥs ʎꞁuO" ʞɔǝɥɔu∩ ˙uoᴉʇɔǝꞁǝs ᵷuᴉʇsᴉxǝ ɹnoʎ uᴉɥʇᴉʍ suoᴉʇdo pᴉꞁɐʌ ʎꞁuo ʍoɥs oʇ pǝɹǝʇꞁᴉɟ ǝq ꞁꞁᴉʍ sᵷɐʇ puɐ sǝɯoᴉq ǝꞁqɐꞁᴉɐʌɐ ɟo ʇsᴉꞁ ǝɥʇ 'ʇꞁnɐɟǝp ʎᗺ %4$s˙ꞁoɹʇuoɔ ɹǝɥʇɹnɟ ǝpᴉʌoɹd uɐɔ ʇnq 'uoᴉʇɔǝꞁǝs ɹnoʎ puoʎǝq ʇuǝɯuᵷᴉssɐ ɐʇɐp puǝʇxǝ ʇou ꞁꞁᴉʍ sᵷuᴉʇʇǝs ǝsǝɥ⟘ ˙ɹǝɥʇɹnɟ ʇɔǝɟɟǝ ǝɥʇ ʇɔᴉɹʇsǝɹ oʇ sǝᴉɹɐpunoq ǝɯoᴉᗺ ᵷuᴉʇsᴉxǝ ǝsn ꞁꞁᴉʍ sᵷɐ⟘ ǝɯoᴉᗺ ɹo sǝɯoᴉᗺ ʎq uoᴉʇɔǝꞁǝs ɹnoʎ ᵷuᴉʞsɐW %3$s˙ʎꞁǝʌᴉʇɔǝdsǝɹ uoᴉʇɔǝꞁǝs ɹnoʎ ʍoꞁǝq ɹo ǝʌoqɐ sʞɔoꞁq ꞁꞁɐ ᵷuᴉpnꞁɔuᴉ 'sᴉxɐ ⅄ ǝɥʇ uo ʇɔǝɟɟǝ ǝɥʇ puǝʇxǝ ꞁꞁᴉʍ "ɹooꞁɟ pꞁɹoʍ oʇ uʍop puǝʇxƎ" puɐ "ᵷuᴉꞁᴉǝɔ pꞁɹoʍ oʇ dn puǝʇxƎ" %2$s˙uoᴉʇɔǝꞁǝs ʇɐɥʇ ɥʇᴉʍ ʇɔɐɹǝʇuᴉ ꞁꞁᴉʍ ʇuǝɯuᵷᴉssɐǝɹ ɐʇɐp ǝɥʇ ʍoɥ ǝuᴉɯɹǝʇǝp oʇ sᵷuᴉʇʇǝs ꞁɐuoᴉʇᴉppɐ ǝsn uɐɔ noʎ 'ꞁǝuɐd ʇuǝɯuᵷᴉssⱯ ɐʇɐᗡ ǝɯoᴉᗺ ǝɥʇ uᴉɥʇᴉM ˙pꞁɹoʍ ǝɥʇ uᴉ uoᴉʇɔǝꞁǝs ɐ ᵷuᴉuᵷᴉssɐǝɹ ǝq ꞁꞁ,no⅄ %1$s

source_string: %s Any areas you've already reassigned will be listed here. Each item shows you the region's current biome assignment, its rough center (in X and Z), and the full height in Y, so you can determine whether the affected area extends to the world ceiling or floor.%s Use %s to move your camera to that location.%s Use %s to change the assignment of that area to another biome.%s It is not currently possible to revert a reassigned area to the world's original state.
translation: ˙ǝʇɐʇs ꞁɐuᴉᵷᴉɹo s,pꞁɹoʍ ǝɥʇ oʇ ɐǝɹɐ pǝuᵷᴉssɐǝɹ ɐ ʇɹǝʌǝɹ oʇ ǝꞁqᴉssod ʎꞁʇuǝɹɹnɔ ʇou sᴉ ʇI %6$s˙ǝɯoᴉq ɹǝɥʇouɐ oʇ ɐǝɹɐ ʇɐɥʇ ɟo ʇuǝɯuᵷᴉssɐ ǝɥʇ ǝᵷuɐɥɔ oʇ %5$s ǝs∩ %4$s˙uoᴉʇɐɔoꞁ ʇɐɥʇ oʇ ɐɹǝɯɐɔ ɹnoʎ ǝʌoɯ oʇ %3$s ǝs∩ %2$s˙ɹooꞁɟ ɹo ᵷuᴉꞁᴉǝɔ pꞁɹoʍ ǝɥʇ oʇ spuǝʇxǝ ɐǝɹɐ pǝʇɔǝɟɟɐ ǝɥʇ ɹǝɥʇǝɥʍ ǝuᴉɯɹǝʇǝp uɐɔ noʎ os '⅄ uᴉ ʇɥᵷᴉǝɥ ꞁꞁnɟ ǝɥʇ puɐ '(Z puɐ X uᴉ) ɹǝʇuǝɔ ɥᵷnoɹ sʇᴉ 'ʇuǝɯuᵷᴉssɐ ǝɯoᴉq ʇuǝɹɹnɔ s,uoᴉᵷǝɹ ǝɥʇ noʎ sʍoɥs ɯǝʇᴉ ɥɔɐƎ ˙ǝɹǝɥ pǝʇsᴉꞁ ǝq ꞁꞁᴉʍ pǝuᵷᴉssɐǝɹ ʎpɐǝɹꞁɐ ǝʌ,noʎ sɐǝɹɐ ʎuⱯ %1$s

translation: ˙spᴉoʌ ɹo ɹᴉɐ-pᴉɯ uᴉ sʞɔoꞁq uᵷᴉꞁɐ puɐ ǝɔɐꞁd oʇ ɹǝᴉsɐǝ ʇᴉ ᵷuᴉʞɐɯ 'ʇsuᴉɐᵷɐ ʞɹoʍ oʇ sꞁooʇ ɹǝɥʇo ɹoɟ ǝɔɐɟɹns ʎɹɐɹodɯǝʇ ɐ ǝpᴉʌoɹd sǝuɐꞁd ǝpᴉn⅁
